title: Hens Under the Hill
summary: Hedda has lost four hens since the thaw, and it wasn't a fox. The hill goblins under the north range have found the carters going the long way round, and come down for whatever else they can carry. She wants their chief told.

steps.journal: Go down two floors into the Scrag Warren, at the foot of the north range past the mill, and put down Old Skarn, the goblin chief who drums.

ready: Go back to Hedda, by the well in Thornwick.
done: Old Skarn's drum is quiet. Hedda won't get her four hens back, but nobody else will lose theirs.
